maddeler.e:
اعتضت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَضْتُ (iʕtaḍtu) /iʕ.tadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# اِعْتَضْتَ (iʕtaḍta) /iʕ.tadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# اِعْتَضْتِ (iʕtaḍti) /iʕ.tadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# اُعْتِضْتُ (uʕtiḍtu) /uʕ.tidˤ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِعْتَا
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
